content.value: The mean and Standard deviation of scores obtained in Mathematics of 60 students of MSE-2K19 batch were found to be 58.25 and 6.3 respectively. Later on it was found on scrutiny that the scores of 56 and 64 of two students has been wrongly recorded as 65and 46 respectively. What is the corrected mean and Standard deviation corresponding to the corrected figures?
